newsitems.title: 3.28.0e Patch Notes Preview
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: Later this week, we’ll be deploying the 3.28.0e patch for Path of Exile: Mirage. The patch will allow certain buff effects to persist through combat areas, as well as introduce further Atlas UI/UX improvements and some bug fixes. Here is a preview! The Mirage Challenge League Some buff effects now transition with you through combat areas like temporary minions. These include Rage, Fortify, most charges, and Shrines (excluding Evolving Shrine). On first moving after entering a Mirage, a powerful shockwave will trigger to stun enemies near the player. This is to mitigate situations where the player is immediately swarmed on entering a Mirage. Corrected the error message that displays when trying to use the Divine Font on an Imbued Gem. Fixed a bug with several wishes that added extra monster packs to the Mirage, where the added packs could be spawned outside the Mirage zone and therefore not appear. Mirages will no longer spawn in a particular City Square room that made them unable to spread very far. The Astral-touched modifier now has special font colouring General Improvements Unique Maps will no longer show the "Bonus Objective" line when viewing the advanced mod descriptions. Fixed a UI bug where some Atlas nodes in the far corners of the Atlas were not hoverable when the corresponding Voidstone had been unlocked. Added more informative error messages when applying Memory Threads to invalid nodes on your Atlas. While viewing the Atlas, hovering or holding a map will cause Atlas nodes of that map tier to highlight with a white glow. The Map Device will no longer show the Maven/Eater/Exarch influence buttons for Unique maps that can't be Witnessed. All uncompleted Unique maps on the Atlas will stop pulsing blue once you have completed any 10 Unique maps. Kirac's Invitation UI will no longer show the Maven/Eater/Exarch influence buttons. While using Chaos Orbs, you can now hold Alt to swap to using an Exalted Orb. Added extra reminder text to the Transfusion Support to state that it prioritises the closest Minion that isn't already at maximum Souls. Bug Fixes Harvest Bosses will transition back into their regular forms 40 seconds after starting a vine phase. The Misty Reflection skill from the Delirious Bloodline can no longer be repeated. Fixes a bug where if the skill repeated your character would be invisible and unusable for the rest of that area. Fixed a bug where you couldn't get Remembrance charges for Legacy of the Rose staff after entering a boss room. Fixed a bug where the last shard fired by Eye of Winter of Transience was in the wrong location Fixed a bug where magic monsters around bismuth ore could have duplicate monster mods Fixed a bug where the Influencing Scarab of Interference couldn't be used alongside the Horned Scarab of Awakening. Fixed a bug where the Shaper time stop during the Nightmare of Lycia boss in the Sanctuary Map could prevent the Nightmare of Lycia from transitioning to her Storm Call phase, rendering the fight ...

newsitems.author: CommunityTeam_GGG
newsitems.contents: Later today we plan to release 3.28.0c which contains a number of Improvements and Changes for Path of Exile: Mirage, including new Wish options, Atlas UI/UX improvements, as well as a number of bug fixes. Check them out! The following patch notes are still subject to change prior to the patch's deployment. The Mirage Challenge League Fixed a bug where Mirages were unable to extend into the Moon Temple boss arena. The Wish for Rust and Wish for Terror now cause the enemies they spawn to spawn when breaking the Astral Chain instead of spawning alongside Final Map Bosses in the Mirage Area. This also now allows these Wishes to appear at any Mirage of sufficient area level, instead of just Mirages within range of a Map Boss. Fixed a bug where Wish for Rust was twice as common in Ruthless. The granted skill to return to the portal in a Mirage is no longer considered a Spell. Empowered Mirage Map items now have special art. Fixed a bug where the mortar projectile spell used by the Astral Instrument monster did no damage. Added the Wish for Flame which grants a Coin of Power on breaking the Astral Chain. Added the Wish for Tides which grants a Coin of Knowledge on breaking the Astral Chain. Added the Wish for Sands which grants a Coin of Skill on breaking the Astral Chain. General Improvements and Changes Shortened the display text for subsequent notifications of Faustus having sold your items. Toast notifications are no longer displayed over the top of the inventory panel. Shrines which attach ongoing secondary effects to the player, such as Shocking Shrine, now have a limit on how many of these effects they can continue to attach through getting many copies of these shrines active at once. All Lost Shipment chests except for the central one are now destructible with damage. The central chest in Lost Shipments also has a more distinctive label now. At the Map Device, hovering a Map or Fragment in your inventory will now highlight the Map Device slots the item can go in. At the Map Device, while in the controller mode players can now select Unique Maps or Boss Fragments from their inventory to navigate to those locations on the Atlas and insert the item into the Map Device. The Map Stash now has 6 subtabs available for each of the Conqueror and Elder Guardian map types. Added a new Harvest Crafting Option to change a stack of League-Specific Astrolabes into a different type of League-Specific Astrolabe. Ailith can now be interacted with from farther away in the Monastery of the Keepers. Hovering a Volatile Vaal Orb over an item now shows the modified range of individual stat values. Vagan's crafting bench to complete Incubators now has a more descriptive label for what interacting with the crafting bench will do. Holy Flame Totems now have an enemy targeting range that matches Spell Totems (for real this time). newsitems.title: Path of Exile: Mirage - What We're Working On
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: Over the weekend, we’ve launched Path of Exile: Mirage. Thanks to everyone who logged in to try out the new league! So far we've deployed 11 hotfixes to address a variety of crashes and bugs. The team continues to work on hotfixes as they investigate your reports and feedback, and we should have the most common issues addressed very soon. We've got plenty of things on our radar currently, but here are some examples of what we're working on: Many instances of the Currency Exchange showing removed items and not showing new ones have been fixed internally and will be hotfixed in the client shortly. Improving the visibility of maps not yet completed on the Atlas. Improving the visibility of Caches in Mirages. Fixing cases where certain UI elements (in Delve, for example) are not selectable. Fixing an issue where users in permanent leagues are unable to progress their Atlas state. We're also making many individual improvements to the experience of the new Atlas system. Fixing an issue where Memory Thread currency was not dropping from Memory Tears after completing all the Memory Lines quests. Soul of Lunaris' 6% reduced Elemental Damage taken if you have been Hit Recently has been changed from Iceberg Map to instead be Beach Map. Ability to have buffs persist through area transitions from one combat area to another, with Shrine Buffs likely to be the first to get this treatment. We are aware of the server issues that affect some of our players, and we are working hard to resolve them as soon as we can. As a reminder, week one Twitch Drops are now active, so remember to link your Twitch account to your Path of Exile account and claim your Mirage Quicksilver Flask Effect and Imprisoned Djinn Merchant by supporting a streamer. newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: In Path of Exile: Mirage you will take on a rogue sect of the Faridun as they sap the energies of captured Djinn for nefarious ends, and help a legendary Maraketh Sekhema put an end to an ancient war once and for all. Our new expansion introduces a new Challenge League, a variety of new and reworked Skill and Support Gems, significant Endgame changes and a plethora of Quality of Life features. The Afarud, the most depraved and twisted of the Faridun, have formed a pact with Saresh, a powerful necromancer who built an army of undead to seek revenge on the Maraketh. They intend to seek out and harness the power of the Djinn, twisting it to their ends to further their war on the Maraketh. Varashta, a powerful Sekhema who has been suspended in time for eons, will assist you as you seek to halt the Afarud's efforts in Wraeclast. In the Mirage Challenge League, you will encounter the souls of Djinn torturously trapped by the Afarud, and work to set them free. Enter the Mirage they project, an imperfect copy of the area around the captured Djinn. Fight your way through the monsters, astral hazards, and Afarud mages to the tether holding the Djinn. Free them, and you will be rewarded. Being a Djinn herself, Varashta can offer you a further mote of ancient Maraketh power, providing you with three wishes to choose from. Each of these is a powerful modifier which will augment the Mirage you enter. The magic of the Mirage will augment any other league mechanic that appears within its dominion. Warped into existence by the Astral realm, these encounters behave differently, and can sometimes provide strange and powerful rewards. The Afarud are not only torturers but thieves, and have over the centuries stolen away countless priceless Maraketh artefacts - but using their magic, they have twisted and warped these to items suit their own purposes. Use the forbidden power of these desecrated artefacts or restore them to their former glory with the aid of Varashta. By meddling in the affairs of the Afarud, you will eventually draw the ire of Saresh, the necromancer supreme. Do you dare to face him and put a stop to his marauding undead legion? In this expansion, we are adding a variety of new Holy Skill Gems. Slam the ground to call down a hammer of justice, summon forth an army of divine armaments, or project the power of the sun into a blast of righteous anger. In Path of Exile: Mirage, extensive changes are coming to the Atlas and Mapping systems. Here is just a few of them: Map items no longer require a specific map item to access an associated map area. Instead, you will have a map item of a given tier that can be used to open any map on your Atlas that matches that tier. The structure of the Atlas has also changed: you will now begin at the centre of the Atlas, with each corner housing one of the four Voidstones, and all content accessed from your map device now exists physically on the Atlas. newsitems.title: What Will Happen When the Keepers League Ends
newsitems.author: CommunityTeam_GGG
newsitems.contents: The Keepers Challenge League will end soon and you may be wondering what will happen when it does. Old-school Breaches will be replaced by those introduced in 3.27 Keepers of the Flame, with both Unstable and Hive Breach encounters appearing naturally in areas from Act 6 onwards. There will be the usual Scarab and Atlas Tree support for a core league mechanic, including the ability to control which type of Breach encounter appears in your maps, if you have a preference one way or another! The Genesis Tree will remain as a method of growing rewards from the flesh of your slain enemies, but Grafts will no longer be available. So, here’s what you can expect when the league ends on March 2nd at 1PM PST Currently equipped Grafts will be deleted. Growing wombgifts will also be deleted, as will any Implant currencies. Any stored Graftblood will be lost. Thanks to everyone for playing and to those of you still trying to complete your unfinished challenges, you still have two weeks to do so before the Keepers League ends. To those of you looking forward to something new, keep an eye on the news for the upcoming 3.28 reveal!

newsitems.title: Play the Legacy of Phrecia Event on January 29th PST!
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: Embrace the bizarre when the Legacy of Phrecia returns to Path of Exile on January 29th (PST)! With 19 alternate Ascendancy classes, battle through areas altered by map modifiers, and face enraged bosses that push your builds and your skill to the limit. The Legacy of Phrecia Start Date: 1PM January 29th PST End Date:1PM February 19th PST Based on: Keepers Platforms: PC and Consoles Standard and Hardcore Solo Self-Found versions available. This event is not voided. Items and characters will transfer to parent leagues at the end of the event. Upon migration, your characters’ Ascendancy points will be respecced and you'll be assigned one of the core Ascendancy classes. In the Legacy of Phrecia event, all the 19 Ascendancy classes you are familiar with will be replaced with new ones. Become a Servant of Arakaali and raise spiders to fight alongside you; use the powers of nature itself as the Daughter of Oshabi or just ascend into a Harbinger - this event manifests the wildest ideas of our design team into reality. If you didn’t play in the original Legacy of Phrecia event you can check out the Ascendancies here. Do note that there have been some balance changes that will vary from this and will be available in the patch notes prior to the event. Idols will also be making a comeback! Since the last time we ran this event, we’ve added a new set of modifiers for the Settlers League and Atlas Memories, but disabled modifiers for Breach. Craft a unique endgame experience by mixing and matching mechanics together as you see fit. With the new Asynchronous trade system getting your perfect set of idols has never been easier! In addition to this, we’ve also sprinkled a few extra twists into the mix. To start with, every area will have a random number of map modifiers, with this number scaling up with area level. We’ve removed many modifiers from the pool that would brick builds, such as reflect. Campaign bosses, as well as some Pinnacles have also developed a few new mechanics for you to overcome. All unique monsters will also enrage on low life. Rewards By reaching levels 50 and 90 you will automatically receive a Third Edict Mystery Box. If you already own all of the contents from this series of Mystery Box then you’ll instead receive 2 x Atlantis Mystery Box. FAQ How do I join? The Legacy of Phrecia will be available as a separate league option on the character creation screen. Will the Legacy of Phrecia event run on all platforms? Yes. The event is available on PC and Consoles. Can I play my existing character? No, you’ll need to make a new character. Can I change my Ascendancy class during the event? Yes. Will I get multiple Mystery Boxes by leveling multiple characters in the event? No, you will only receive these rewards once per account, so additional characters will not be granted additional rewards.

newsitems.title: Keepers of the Flame Build Showcase
newsitems.author: kiki
newsitems.contents: Today, we will be showcasing some neat builds from Keepers of the Flame. Whether it’s something new or something powerful, we hope these builds inspire you. This is just a brief overview, so if you want to learn more about any of them, check out the links to the creators! Jorgen’s Spectral Helix Gladiator First up, we have a Spectral Helix Gladiator created by Jorgen, a build with an unreasonable amount of health that lets you face-tank Uber bosses with ease. To get these defenses, he utilises the new Aul Bloodline Ascendancy's Precursor's Release, so that you cannot be stunned, take no extra damage from critical strikes, and cannot be slowed if you have no socketed gems in your helmet, gloves, and boots. For health, they changed the colours of the empty sockets to red so they can use The Untouched Soul Amulet for a significant increase in maximum life. Then, they also use The Apostate armour, complemented by Warlock Gloves and Boots, to turn maximum Energy Shield to maximum Life. Of course, with such a ridiculous health pool we might wonder if we can turn it into damage scaling. Jorgen has done just that by using the Grey Wind Spectral Axe, which adds fire damage equal to 12% of the player's maximum life, and Rathpith Globe Shield to increase spell damage per 100 player maximum life. Lolcohol’s Kinetic Fusillade Elementalist There’s a new skill in 3.27 and it’s Kinetic Fusillade, a hovering kinetic projectile that can shoot like a machine gun if you know how to tweak it. In this build, Lolcohol is going to show us how. To reduce the base duration before the projectile is fired, they used Timeclasp Ring, Warped Timepiece Amulet and Less Duration Gem. For further duration reduction, they recommend anointing your amulet with the Window of Opportunity or Hasty Demise passive. They are able to reduce the duration from 0.7 seconds to 0.07 seconds in this build! Even though it looks simple, they have some additional tips to make sure that you can utilise the speed without sacrificing the damage in his video guide here. GhazzyTV’s Dark Pact Necromancer In this video, GhazzyTV is going to show us a budget friendly build utilising the new Bloodline Ascendancy supporting minion skills. This build uses two button rotations between Summon Skeleton and Dark Pact that will chain between the Skeleton and bring it to the enemy. With Catarina’s Bloodline, it can increase our damage and the health of our minions so the Dark Pact can sustain longer. PhazePlay’s Bleed Slam of Earthshaking Slayer Our final build today is a fantastic mapper build with enormous damage. With the transfigured version of Ground Slam, it can provide screenwide coverage! For a Bleed Slam build, they use Static Strike and Vulnerability to aggravate bleeding, then Rallying Cry for a damage buff. After that, spam your slam to get the bleed rolling. newsitems.title: Keepers of the Flame - What We’re Working On
newsitems.author: CommunityTeam_GGG
newsitems.contents: It’s been almost a week since the launch of Keepers of the Flame, and our team continues to monitor community feedback. Over the past few days, we’ve deployed several hotfixes and a patch to address some of the issues players have been experiencing. In this news post, we’d like to outline what we’re currently working on. We are re-assessing the rewards from Breach monsters in map areas with an eye towards making the league mechanic encounters more rewarding directly, and thus more worth the time to engage with. We’re aware of the feedback regarding Hive encounters, with players frustrated by having to spend too much time destroying walls before the encounter. We’re investigating an option to allow a large number of walls to be destroyed at the start of the encounter. We have another batch of Foulborn uniques which didn’t quite make it into launch and will be going in with the next restart patch. Outside of Breach-specific changes, we are aware of feedback from players that late endgame farming strategies are currently lacking in diversity and progression. We are putting together a list of adjustments to address this, with an emphasis on making currently underperforming strategies more competitive. We are targeting next week for the release of these changes. A larger amount of changes to this area are planned for 3.28. We plan to deploy some of these changes, along with additional fixes and improvements, next week. Keep an eye out on the news for the full list of changes. Thank you for your continued feedback!

newsitems.title: What We're Working On
newsitems.author: CommunityTeam_GGG
newsitems.contents: The launch of Path of Exile: Keepers of the Flame over the weekend was one of our smoothest launches ever. Thanks to everyone who logged in to try it out! Since the initial 3.27.0 patch, we've made seven hotfixes which addressed a variety of bug fixes, crashes, and balance changes to the new Breach mechanic. There are additional hotfixes already in the pipeline to address bugs such as the old Breach mechanic still being available in the Temple of Atzoatl, and further balance changes to the new Breach mechanic. Hive Fortress encounters will soon be receiving some changes to make them easier to complete and less punishing if you fail. Ailith will create skills more frequently during Hive Fortress encounters. Note there is a maximum of 6 skill objects active at a time. Increased the internal cooldown for which Ailith can be damaged. This cooldown becomes longer the more damage she takes from an individual hit. This should help mitigate Ailith being bursted down in a few seconds. Failing a Hive or Hive Fortress encounter will now drop all the loot of the monsters you had killed up to that point. However, you will not gain any Graftblood or Wombgifts. Ranged monsters now have to be closer to Ailith in order to attack her. As a reminder, week one Twitch Drops are now active, so remember to link your Twitch account to your Path of Exile account and claim your Exile's Treasurer Hideout Decoration and Breachlord's Claw Character Effect! Information on the Twitch Drops and how to link your account can be found in this news post.

newsitems.title: Keepers of the Flame FAQ
newsitems.author: kiki
newsitems.contents: Following the Keepers of the Flame Content Reveal last week, we've seen a lot of questions about this update to Path of Exile. Check out the answers to some of the most frequently asked questions below. What is happening with content that is tied to Breach? Breachstones will still work in standard, but are unobtainable in Keepers Leagues. Breach Scarabs will be unavailable in the Keepers league. Chayula on Maven’s Invitation: The Feared has been replaced with the Incarnation of Ignorance. Maven’s Invitation: The Hidden is now replaced with The Remembered, requiring Witness of Courtyard of Wasting, Chambers of Impurity and Theatre of Lies. It That Fled does not appear in Betrayal encounters in Keepers Leagues. Will the identification of items use the Ctrl+Click shortcut from Path of Exile 2? The quick shortcut for item identification is Ctrl+Alt+Click on Mouse and Keyboard. Can all uniques be Foulborn? Not all uniques can be Foulborn, the list of uniques that can be is still ongoing however there will be more than one hundred. Uniques that come from specific sources, such as boss uniques cannot be Foulborn. Have there been any changes made to the frequency of finding Aul in Delve? The frequency of Aul appearing in Delve is unchanged. Will Faustus in the Rogue harbour also be able to manage asynchronous trade? Faustus asynchronous trade will only be available in hideouts. Will we be able to change our Bloodline ascendancy and how? Yes, you can respec your current Bloodline ascendancy with another for free (after defeating a relevant boss). Otherwise, you can use Orbs of Regret or gold to respec those points like normal ascendancy points (5 refund points each). Can multiple party members all get the same Bloodline ascendancy from the same boss? Yes, assuming they are in the fight when the boss is killed. Will Windburst Support work with movement from things like Flame Dash or Flicker Strike? Yes. It counts movement from travel skills as well as regular movement. Will graft skills scale off my damage and am I able to die from my graft skills reflected damage? Graft skills do not scale off of player stats, but do have affixes which will affect their skills in many ways. Since graft damage is not dealt by the player, reflected damage will not be dealt back to the player from graft skill use. How many Spectral Tigers can you have and how much Critical Chance, Attack and Cast Speed do they give? You can have up to 5 of them and each of them grants 25% Increased Critical Chance, 7% Increased Attack Speed and 7% Increased Cast Speed. We’ll continue to monitor for questions and will continue to update this post when we do. Thank you so much for your continued support, we'll see you at launch!

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 3.27 tests the waters on sequel mechanics, but its director tells us he wants to avoid "cutting corners"
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents: Twelve years on from its full launch, Path of Exile 3.27 marks a new frontier for one of the best RPGs on PC; a game beloved by its hardcore community for the level of depth and creativity in every update. The new seasonal league, Keepers of the Flame, is the first time developer Grinding Gear Games has delivered a direct sequel to one of its old mechanics, and it's picked a big one. Breach, which first appeared in 2016, is a simple but satisfying stalwart that was one of the systems hand-picked to make the jump to side-by-side sequel Path of Exile 2. So, ahead of the new PoE update, I spoke with game director Mark Roberts to ask what inspired the choice, bolstering quality of life, and how dual development is going. Read the rest of the story...
